start:
set -euo pipefail
if node -e 'fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9000/").then(() => process.exit(0)).catch(() => process.exit(1))'; then
  echo "Terrene dev server already listening on port 9000"
  exit 0
fi
./node_modules/.bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json
exec ./node_modules/.bin/webpack serve --config webpack.development.js --host 0.0.0.0 --port 9000
